jobs.title: Cash Equities CRB Quant Developer
jobs.description:
• We are seeking an experienced candidate to join our Cash Equities CRB Quantitative Developer team within UBS Global Markets
• This is a fast paced and collaborative team that are responsible for the development and enhancement of the best-in-class Cash Equities platform
• The team sits within the Global Markets Principal Flow Trading stream, and has a business reporting line
• You will be operating within a high-performing, fast paced quant development team, whose goals are directly aligned to the success of the business
• You will take ownership of initiatives from initial analysis through to design, implementation and delivery
• You will proactively suggest and drive through improvements to the platform and our framework
• You will be involved in every aspect of algorithmic trading:
o Market connectivity
o Designing, implementing and back-testing hedging, risk management and execution strategies
o Designing and building analytics to assess model and platform performance
o Latency analysis and optimisation
o Enhancing the proprietary eTrading framework that is used across the department

jobs.title: Audit Expert, IB Derivatives & Solutions
jobs.description:
Are you a sharp evaluator of risk, who enjoys investigating complex business processes and products? Do you want to play a key role in improving the effectiveness of business critical processes to help safeguard and strengthen UBS?

We’re looking for a Risk Expert or Auditor to:

• plan, execute and lead audits, issue assurance, and risk assessment reviews according to our internal standards that are fully supported by the work done.
• highlight where controls are functioning well or where UBS needs to act to better manage current and emerging risks, and escalate any significant concerns or issues appropriately.
• meet our internal standards for the quality, execution and documentation of assurance work, taking account of legal entity coverage expectations, where required.
• proactively and successfully collaborate with peers in and across audit teams.
• build and maintain constructive relationships with colleagues and relevant stakeholders at all levels including senior management.
• continuously assess the risk profile of the relevant UBS IB businesses.
• participate in regulatory inspections and address inquiries from regulators

jobs.title: Card Processing Specialist
jobs.description:
As a key member of the Cards Processing Team, you will serve as a hands-on individual contributor supporting critical card processing activities and ensuring accurate, timely, and well-controlled execution of daily operations between UBS, internal business partners, and card vendors. This role is ideal for a detail-oriented operations professional with strong accounting and reconciliation experience who can identify exceptions, research issues, and help maintain a high-quality experience for branch and business stakeholders by:

Support the end-to-end card lifecycle, including production, personalization, distribution, maintenance, and issue resolution, while helping ensure service levels are met and operational risks are identified and addressed promptly.

Perform reconciliations across multiple general ledgers and card processing accounts, researching outages, transaction breaks, and exceptions to support timely resolution and reduce financial and operational risk.

jobs.title: Research Analyst - Global Growth Equity
jobs.description:
Do you want to use your fundamental equity market expertise and portfolio management knowledge to help manage portfolios and identify new investment opportunities? Are you a strong communicator who works well in a team-oriented structure? Do you want to be a part of a growing business within a well-established asset management platform?

We’re looking for a Research Analyst - Global Growth Equity to:

• assist lead portfolio managers with research activities on US and Global equities that reflect the investment strategies for our client mandates
• identify and assess new and existing investment opportunities using both fundamental bottom-up company driven analysis and top-down market level research
• help implement and manage investment strategies, support product workflows and models, and monitor performance and risks
• effectively communicate portfolio performance and positioning to key stakeholders
• coordinate research efforts with internal teams
• support the improvement of our processes and proprietary portfolio management systems

jobs.description:
"The SAP S/4HANA Finance Delivery Lead supports the delivery of core SAP S/4HANA Finance capabilities within the ampliFi program, with primary accountability across General Ledger (GL), Group Reporting (GR), consolidation, reporting, and the broader Finance & Controlling (FI/CO) landscape. The role is responsible for driving disciplined execution across functional design, business validation, testing readiness, and production transition, ensuring that finance processes, close activities, and reporting outcomes are delivered in line with UBS accounting principles, governance, and control standards.
The role partners closely with Finance, Group Reporting and Consolidation teams, Data, Integration, and Technology stakeholders and acts as a functional representative for S/4HANA Finance within the delivery. It ensures that business requirements are translated into robust, well‑controlled finance solutions aligned with the target architecture and capable of supporting stable close, consolidation, and reporting cycles.

Key Responsibilities
- Support end‑to‑end functional delivery for assigned SAP S/4HANA Finance workstreams covering General Ledger, Group Reporting, consolidation, and reporting within the ampliFi finance stack, with clear ownership of outcomes.
- Contribute to and review functional designs and configurations across FI/CO to ensure alignment with agreed solution architecture, accounting principles, and reporting requirements.
- Ensure that S/4HANA Finance solutions support accurate posting, close, consolidation, and reporting outcomes, including integration with upstream subledgers and downstream reporting consumers.
- Develop and maintain delivery plans covering functional scope, milestones, dependencies, and impacts across S/4HANA Finance integration points and reporting consumption.
- Proactively manage risks, issues, and dependencies (RAID), with a focus on financial accuracy, close stability, consolidation integrity, and regulatory expectations, escalating where required.
- Coordinate day‑to‑day delivery across Finance, Group Reporting, Data, Integration, Testing, and Deployment teams to ensure coherent end‑to‑end execution across close, consolidation, and reporting cycles.
- Ensure adherence to agreed delivery standards, accounting principles, design decisions, and change control processes across the S/4HANA Finance scope.
- Support SIT and UAT execution from a functional perspective, including validation of close and consolidation scenarios, assessment of defects based on finance impact, and support for business sign‑off.
- Assist with production readiness and cutover preparation, focusing on stability of financial close and consolidation cycles, accuracy of balances and reports, and smooth transition to business‑as‑usual operations post go‑live.
"

Can you also close a deal?

• continuously grow your network by referrals and by identifying new prospects
• acquire the necessary knowledge and sales skills to deliver the UBS value proposition to clients, including timely completion of mandatory trainings and the WM Certificate

jobs.description:

• drive initiatives related to sales supervision, compliance and business risk, including implementation and education

• partner with Compliance, including providing input to policy and supporting communication of policies
• serve as a point of contact for issues that cannot be resolved, and escalate issues as required

jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.description:
Are you interested in starting your journey as a Product Manager and working closely with Operations and Technology teams? Are you passionate about improving end user experience and using data and technology— including AI — to drive meaningful operational change?
We’re looking for a Product Manager (AO) to join the Collateral Crew, specifically within the Margin & Interest Workflow pod. The pod is responsible for driving meaningful change in margin call issuance processes, leveraging AI and automation to improve accuracy, efficiency, and user experience.
You will work closely with Operations users and the collateral crew to understand pain points, support delivery of solutions, and help ensure successful rollout and adoption.

Key responsibilities would include, but are not limited to:
• Support ownership of one or more Collateral Operations products or services within the Margin & Interest Workflow pod.
• Work closely with Collateral Operations users to understand day to day margin and interest workflows and identify pain points.
• Help identify opportunities to improve efficiency, reduce risk, and enhance user experience, particularly within margin call issuance processes.
• Assist in capturing and translating stakeholder requirements into clear, structured inputs for the delivery team.
• Support demand clarification and backlog prioritization in partnership with senior Product Managers and engineering leads.
• Contribute to the development and maintenance of product backlogs, ensuring user needs are clearly articulated.
• Work with Technology teams to support delivery of solutions that leverage AI and automation to improve margin processes.
• Participate in user demos, showcases, and walkthroughs of new functionality.
• Actively support user adoption, gathering feedback and helping teams understand and embed new solutions.
• Track and communicate basic outcomes of delivered changes (e.g. usability improvements, reduced manual effort).
• Support compliance with risk, control, and security requirements by working with relevant stakeholders.
• Assist with audit or control activities by helping ensure documentation and evidence are up to date.

Are you good at handling and interpreting large data sets?
Are you analytical and enjoy investigating financial transactions, understanding trading strategies and making sense of the unusual trading activity?
Are you able to think independently and express your opinions and ideas confidently?

• Engaging with business stakeholders on the market conduct-related escalations and other matters.

• This job description provides a high-level review of the types of work performed. Other job-related duties may be assigned as required.

jobs.description:
Als Remote Advisor Mortgage bist du die erste Anlaufstelle für Neukundinnen, die sich mit einer der wichtigsten finanziellen Entscheidungen ihres Lebens beschäftigen – der Finanzierung ihres Eigenheims. Mit deinem Fachwissen, deiner Begeisterung für den Vertrieb und deiner Fähigkeit, Vertrauen aufzubauen, begleitest du Kundinnen von der ersten Beratung bis zum Abschluss. Gemeinsam mit einem engagierten Team und modernsten digitalen Tools machst du die Hypothekarberatung von morgen erfolgreich.

Deine Aufgaben:
• Du berätst Neukund*innen zu Hypothekengeschäften – flexibel, digital und immer mit einem offenen Ohr für ihre individuellen Bedürfnisse.
• Du gewinnst aktiv neue Kund*innen im Affluent-Segment und baust langfristige Beziehungen auf.
• Du führst Finanzierungsgespräche, prüfst Kreditanfragen und entwickelst passgenaue Finanzierungslösungen.
• Du kooperierst mit externen Finders (z. B. Immobilienmakler, Vermittler), um Leads zu generieren und erfolgreich abzuschliessen.
• Du stellst sicher, dass alle regulatorischen Vorgaben und Compliance-Standards eingehalten werden.

• develop and maintain complex financial models to support decision-making

• prepare high-quality presentations and materials for internal and external stakeholders
• collaborate closely with business divisions, group functions and external advisors

jobs.description:
We are looking for a Marketing Strategist to support the UBS Global Wealth Management (GWM) business across the APAC region. Working as part of the regional Market Coverage team, you will set a clear, data-informed direction for brand and marketing activation across APAC countries and segments, ensure alignment with divisional priorities, and orchestrate partnerships that amplify growth, reputation, and client impact.

Scope & Impact
• Work with the GWM regional marketing heads for Greater China, SEA/Japan and Australia and APAC Head of Marketing to shape the end-to-end Brand & Marketing planning process, integrating funnel goals and in-market priorities to deliver measurable outcomes.
• Partner with IB and AM Marketing coverage and Media and Communications teams to foster stronger cross-divisional coordination and One Bank brand and marketing initiatives
• Provide strategic guidance on value propositions, go-to-market strategies, key growth projects in partnership with the business and ensure narratives remain coherent and client-centric.
• Lead a team specialised in digital client acquisition marketing efforts, collaborating across functions, divisions and external partners to design and execute innovative campaigns that drive awareness, interest and engagement in new and existing audiences
• Work hand in hand with Marketing Excellence Labs (MELs), leveraging their expertise and insight for the benefit of the APAC region to deliver efficient and effective campaigns that grow existing clients and generate leads.
• Act as a senior marketing advisor with an increased focus on Australia as a new and valuable GWM book and where IB is already strong and Japan where the business across the Group is ambitious to grow further.

Key Responsibilities

Strategy & Planning
• Help define GWM’s multi-year marketing strategy and annual plan, including objectives by funnel stage and region, target-setting approach, and governance cadence.
• Translate strategic priorities into integrated campaign roadmaps, briefing requirements, and KPIs; ensure consistency between top-funnel brand goals and mid/bottom-funnel performance targets.
• Maintain a live portfolio view of programs, reallocating resources to the highest-impact opportunities amid constrained budgets and competitive noise.

Regional & Cross-Divisional Support
• Provide an objective APAC-wide perspective to avoid fragmented approaches and ensure cohesive regional strategy.
• Support a cross-divisional construct offering strategic advice and partnering with on-the-ground teams to deliver integrated outcomes. Seek out efficiencies by collaborating with IB, AM and P&C divisions to collectively achieve positive business and client outcomes.
• Bring to life regional on-the-ground knowledge of client behaviours and market dynamics for the benefit of all APAC country plans.

Briefing & Creative Excellence
• Co-create creative/media briefs that demand non-traditional ideas capable of breaking through clutter and driving earned amplification; steward agencies / internal teams to that quality bar.
• Ensure briefs specify funnel requirements by market and articulate how partners will support GWM to align targets and evaluation frameworks.

Measurement & Optimization
• Set and socialize measurement frameworks linking funnel progression to accelerate acquisition and business outcomes; run quarterly reviews to optimize mix, creative, and partnerships against target deltas.
• Champion test-and-learn performance marketing (new formats/channels, neuroscience or message testing) to continuously sharpen propositions and creative effectiveness.

jobs.description:
Role:
This role will continue to drive key responsibilities within the STAAT Analytics team. The candidate will lead the development of scalable, insight-driven dashboards and advanced analytical solutions that empower strategic decision-making for financial advisory and market leadership. The role requires a strong ability to translate complex data into actionable insights, ensuring stakeholders have the tools and intelligence needed to optimize performance and identify growth opportunities.

• Conduct comprehensive exploratory data analysis and develop predictive models to drive key strategic initiatives.

• Integrate data from diverse sources, including ADW, BODI, and internal data marts, ensuring accuracy and consistency across analytics outputs.
• Automate data pipelines and reporting workflows using Python and Power BI, enhancing efficiency and reliability.
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure analytics deliverables are aligned with overarching business objectives.

For our Country Risk Internship / Economics, Data & AI Program we are looking for someone who can help us to:
• support the team in managing country risk data and processes for rating and model reviews
• contribute to innovation projects through AI/LLM adoption and data/process automation/visualization
• proactively engage with team members to support deliverables in the areas of country and sectoral risk

jobs.title: Data Scientist
jobs.description:
Are you excited to work with a global team with diverse backgrounds and talents? Can you apply your technical skills to help quantify business risks? Do you enjoy the challenge of driving business impact through analytics and are looking for an opportunity to lead innovation?

We’re looking for a Data Scientist to:

• engage in audits to analyze data using traditional machine learning or Large Language Models to uncover trends, patterns, or anomalies for auditors to investigate further.
• work collaboratively with stakeholders to assist in risk assessments and highlight high-risk areas for deep dives.
• clearly communicate complex insights derived from analytics to senior stakeholders in a manner that is both engaging and impactful.
• stay up to date with advancements in AI, ML, and NLP to implement cutting-edge solutions, such as working with the latest Large Language Models (LLMs).
• provide auditors with training and support, as required, to effectively use data-driven tools and solutions.
